title: SoftwareTechnology
description: ITIP domain archetype — software technology classification. Typing: extends gsm:Structure (single-base $ref). Facets: composes ScapPlatformIdentifier (CPE 2.3 identification dimension) via allOf, inheriting its properties (cpeUri, part, vendor, product, version, etc.). Adds: (1) 'type' — governance-relevant functional role; (2) 'settings' — the configuration knobs this technology defines, each carrying its CCE identifier (NIST CCE enumeration) for cross-framework traceability. CPE part mapping: type OPERATING_SYSTEM / HYPERVISOR → CPE part 'o'; all other types → CPE part 'a'. Norm assertions use CEL comprehensions over settings: settings.exists(s, s.name == "ssl" && s.value == "on"). Source: ITIP (domain taxonomy for IT technology governance).

type.description: Functional role of the software technology in the IT landscape. Governance-relevant classification enabling technology standards, approval workflows, and architectural constraints. CPE part mapping: OPERATING_SYSTEM / HYPERVISOR → CPE part 'o'; all others → CPE part 'a'. Examples: PostgreSQL → RELATIONAL_DATABASE, Apache Kafka → MESSAGE_BROKER, Kubernetes → CONTAINER_ORCHESTRATOR, Red Hat Enterprise Linux → OPERATING_SYSTEM.

settings.description: Configuration knobs this technology defines. Each entry identifies a discrete configurable parameter, tagged with its NIST CCE identifier when one exists. Norm assertions evaluate settings via CEL comprehensions: settings.exists(s, s.cceId == "CCE-80214-3" && s.value == "no").

cce.description: SCAP CCE entry formally identifying this configuration concept. Carries the full CCE schema (cceId, settingDescription, platform, technicalMechanism, parameters) validated against ScapConfigurationSetting. Omit when no CCE entry exists for this setting.

name.description: Configuration parameter name as used by the technology (e.g., 'PermitRootLogin', 'ssl', 'max_connections').

value.description: Required value for governance compliance (e.g., 'no', 'on', '100'). String-typed to accommodate all parameter types uniformly.
